title: the-hollow-skips-only-the-instrument
intention: The hollow skips a file under proofs/ only when it is part of the ticket's instrument (a proof whose PROVES names the ticket, or a proofs/ module such a proof imports); any other proof file the build wrote is the build's subject, so the hollow reverts it and watches the instruments' teeth.
why: Measured 2026-10-05: 580ad3b46cd0 (the trees tool's proof measures only the tool, a RULE 1 fix) moved two checks out of one proof into another; its build wrote only proofs/ files, so `cairn test --hollow` skipped both as instruments, read nothing, and clearance refused PROVED with [hollow_nothing_measured] and sent it to FIXME. The trees proof was the build's subject, not its instrument: the librarian proof watching it was. Every encapsulation row that sits in a proof (most of the ~89 standing) is fixed by a proof-only build, so each would dead-end the same way.
traces_to: Law 8 (nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build couldn't pass) and RULE 1 (encapsulation): fixing an encapsulation row that sits in a proof is a proof-only build, and today the hollow can never measure one, so every such fix dead-ends at PROVED. The fix widens what the hollow measures; it softens nothing.
how: In cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py, _classify takes the ticket's instrument set: the proofs proven_by returns that declare a PROVES entry for the ticket, plus every proofs/ module they import (AST, transitively; e.g. test_design_sha imports test_rehearsal, test_call_time_binding imports proofs/fixtures) and returns SKIP_INSTRUMENT for a proofs/ path only when it is in that set; every other proofs/ path is measured like source. The docstring's refusal (1) is restated as 'the instrument', with the measured case. A proof in the tester's own proofs/ shows: a build whose only writes_to is a non-instrument proof gets that file reverted and its tooth watched; an instrument file in writes_to is still skipped; a build writing only instruments still reads hollow_nothing_measured.
falsifier: RED if after the build (1) measure() over a scratch ticket whose writes_to holds a proofs/ file that is neither a proven_by proof nor imported by one skips it as SKIP_INSTRUMENT instead of reverting it; (2) a proven_by proof, or a proofs/ module a proven_by proof imports, in writes_to is reverted; (3) a run whose writes_to holds only instrument files stops raising/reading nothing measured; (4) test_hollow.py, test_the_hollow_anchor_ignores_instrument_commits.py or test_the_hollow_measures_the_repaired_build.py goes red. Horizon: 580ad3b46cd0's hollow retaken after PROVED measures cairn/devices/librarian/tools/trees/proofs/test_trees_is_a_published_tool.py load-bearing. WRONG INTENT if a non-instrument proof's revert reds an instrument tooth for a reason other than the build being reverted.
watchme: none, because the hollow reading is itself sealed on every validation it measures (evidence.hollow, read by clearance.hollow_lacks at cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/clearance.py), so every future proof-only build's PROVED is the watch
children: none, because the change is one function and its three call sites inside cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py plus one new proof
questions: none, because open-155ed994d17b's answer ('the gate stays hard', CairnCommons/questions/open-155ed994d17b.json) is kept, and the hollow module's own docstring states the reason for the skip as 'reverting the instrument', which this ticket makes literal
builder_notes: WHICH function? hollow.py _classify(rel) gains a keyword `instrument: frozenset[str] = frozenset()` and returns SKIP_INSTRUMENT for a proofs/ path only when rel is in it; WHICH callers? the three in hollow.py (build_anchor line 251, the measure loop lines 756 and 762); build_anchor gains an `instrument` keyword it passes through. WHERE is the set built? a new function `instrument_set(proofs, repo_root)` in hollow.py: proofs plus the AST import closure restricted to files under a proofs/ directory that exist in the repo. ORDER in measure(): proofs = proven_by(...) moves above build_anchor. WHICH proof? new cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_hollow_skips_only_the_instrument.py on scratch repos in the pattern of test_the_hollow_anchor_ignores_instrument_commits.py. Decision lines carry the rest.
